notes: This portable slice checks the populated standard MIM publication-query response for one joined subject that publishes one adapter-supplied object class/attribute and one adapter-supplied interaction class, while publishing no directed interactions. It verifies the object and interaction publication payloads and the standard empty directed-interaction response. It does not cover multiple published classes, NULL ordinary publication responses, populated directed publications, publication subscriptions, DDM regions, or overall MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: The subject declares the adapter-selected object-class attribute as published; the test then checks that the standard MIM report identifies that class and includes the declared attribute handle.
The subject declares the adapter-selected interaction class as published; the test checks that the standard MIM interaction-class list reports that class.
The requester uses the standard sendInteraction service and parameter map to identify the joined subject of the publication query.

requirements.source_symbol: HLArequestPublications; HLAreportObjectClassPublication; HLAreportInteractionPublication; HLAreportDirectedInteractionPublication; HLAattributeHandleList; HLAinteractionClassHandleList
requirements.statement: A request for the subject's publication state yields the object-class report for each published object class, the interaction publication report, and the directed-interaction report. With no directed interactions published, the latter uses the standard NULL shape: zero classes, omitted object-class parameter, and an empty interaction-class list. The test decodes reported attribute and interaction-class handles using the public RTIambassador decoding services.
